notes: Partition verified: s001–s014 and t001–t016 each appear once; the two discontinuous units ('make ... straight' and 'that ... which') interleave, which rule 25 allows.
'that ... which' is one unit on the written אֲשֶׁר under rule 46's first rider, headed on 'which'; the resumptive object suffix on ʿiwwəṯô is the unrendered occurrence (rule 22).

The article on hā-ʾĕlōhîm takes the phrase's single 'the', fronted because the rectum is rendered anarthrously (rule 29); the לְ before the infinitive is `unrepresented` because the modal takes a bare complement (rule 52).
